assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No official polygon is available for the three scope levels or three key areas; submitted boundary geometry is the repository-maintained provisional substitute.
assumptions.impact: All maps and recalculated areas are intake/design-discussion aids, never official redlines, precise area evidence, approvals, or implementation bases.

assumptions.statement: Repository Issue #1029 reports that the provisional Dazhongsi key-area centroid lies approximately 2.26 km from Dazhongsi station and near Beijing North Railway Station.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi proposals use broad programmatic and handover-field logic only; no parcel, station-quadrant, route, or engineering placement is claimed until corrected or official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, sections, intersection controls, cycling geometry and traffic studies are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Ground-language paths and crossing/berth diagrams are conceptual organization only and require transport, accessibility and safety design.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries, ownership, access rights and property-management permissions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No site is promised, acquired, demolished, retained or altered; pilot locations remain candidate spatial types subject to owner and authority agreement.

assumptions.statement: Verified existing building footprints, heights, uses, ages and conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building-related geometry remains a scaffold-level conceptual layer and supports no demolition, capacity or structural conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries and construction-control zones for the Jing-Zhang corridor and historic station assets are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All markers are reversible surface concepts located outside protected fabric unless and until heritage review approves a precise installation.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, fire access, flood, snow/ice, pavement structure and maintenance contracts are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Materials, attachment, drainage and winter performance are test questions, not engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The six glyphs are a research proposal and have not been validated by blind, low-vision, wheelchair or neurodiverse users, nor certified under accessibility standards.
assumptions.impact: No tactile form may enter a public pilot until user co-design confirms it is distinguishable from statutory tactile paving and creates no trip, slip, confusion or exclusion risk.

assumptions.statement: Cross-vendor machine readability, occlusion behavior, weather durability and robot default-stop performance are unverified design targets.
assumptions.impact: The proposal does not authorize autonomous operation; supervised tests must fail safe and defer to law, human instructions and professional operating rules.
